task:
Create a Job named 'batch-job' in namespace 'default' that:
  - Uses image: perl:5.34
  - Runs command: perl -Mbignum=bpi -wle 'print bpi(2000)'
  - Completes successfully 3 times
  - Runs 2 pods in parallel
  - Has a backoff limit of 4
hints: Use kubectl create job with --dry-run to get template
Edit the YAML to add completions and parallelism
spec.completions controls how many successful runs
detailed_hints: kubectl create job batch-job --image=perl:5.34 --dry-run=client -o yaml > batch-job.yaml
